name: Mamagoto ~Mama to Naisho no Ecchi Shimasho~
original_name: ままごと ～ママとないしょのエッチしましょ～
source:
The main character returned to his parents' home after graduating high school, but there is awkwardness with his family because of his long dormitory life.

He shared it with his mother's senior and neighbor, Kyoko Kawashima, but she actually wanted the protagonist to be her own son. She set up naughty skinship in form of advise so that the protagonist would become obsessed with her.

However, his mother, Chikage, notices it and desperately tries to get closer to her son, So that he would not be stolen from her. However, she got too excited about her own son--!? 

In addition, his tsundere younger sister Aki and Kyoko's daughter Yuma participate in the battle, and the kinky family's skinship around the hero begins!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1065591]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角高中毕业后回到父母家，却因长期的宿舍生活而与家人产生尴尬。

他与母亲的前辈兼邻居川岛恭子分享了这个故事，但她实际上希望主角是她自己的儿子。她以建议的形式设置了调皮的亲密关系，让主角对她着迷。

然而，他的母亲千景注意到了这一点，并拼命试图靠近她的儿子，这样他就不会被从她身边偷走。然而，她对自己的儿子太兴奋了——！？

此外，傲娇妹妹亚希和恭子的女儿由麻也参战，围绕主人公的淫家族的肌肤之亲就此展开！

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1065591]Getchu[/url]]
